Definition: {a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south}
BiblicalUsage: Yâm is the Aramaic word for the sea, the great water that stirs under the winds of heaven. Daniel saw the four winds strive upon the great sea, and four great beasts came up out of it, each different from the others.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sea in Daniel is the nations in uproar, and God sits above the storm that frightens kings.
